constants.$comment: EVERY constant this course will touch, with its status. DECLARED means the engine states it and nothing in this package derives it. EXPORTED means the engine exports it so a caller can read it. DERIVED means the engine computes it from a closed form and the validation oracle re-derives it by an independent route. HELD means no route in this package can derive it, so it is taught as a stated limit and NEVER GRADED. Every HELD entry names what the oracle can and cannot check. The digest's audit section is the standing form of this table and section 2 MEASURES every figure in it.
constants.520: the leading constant of the USC gas coefficient C. DERIVED: the oracle builds the isentropic nozzle mass flux from R, M, T and P in absolute SI, so the USC constant is checked rather than repeated. MEASURED in digest section 2
constants.735: the leading constant of the USC subcritical area. DERIVED: the oracle integrates the subcritical nozzle flux from the isentropic expansion. MEASURED in section 2
constants.38: the leading constant of the USC liquid area. DERIVED: checked against the published SI 11.78. MEASURED in section 2
constants.51.5: the leading constant of the USC steam area. DERIVED: checked against the published SI 190.4 and the SI statement of Napier. MEASURED in section 2
constants.2800: the constant in the liquid Reynolds relation. DERIVED: the oracle builds rho u D over mu in SI with D as sqrt(4A/pi). MEASURED in section 2
constants.0.9935: the intercept of the Kv viscosity fit. HELD. An empirical fit no route in this package can derive, SHARED with the oracle on purpose and said so in both headers. Planted in both files the published suite stays green. What the published set CAN discriminate is engine-side drift, through its Reynolds 92 row. MEASURED in section 2 and NEVER GRADED
constants.2.878: the inverse-root term of the same Kv fit. HELD, on the same terms. MEASURED in section 2 and NEVER GRADED
constants.342.75: the inverse-three-halves term of the same Kv fit. HELD, on the same terms, and the one whose band the digest prints term by term across a Reynolds sweep so the band is computed rather than asserted. MEASURED in section 2 and NEVER GRADED
constants.1.0065396: the asymptote the UNCLAMPED Kv fit reaches, which would let a correction for viscous drag ADD capacity. MEASURED in section 2 from liquidKvUnclamped, which the engine exports so the asymptote stays inspectable. The CLAMP at 1.0 is a stated CONVENTION of this engine, pinned by the suite
constants.24 / 3 / 0.34: the three terms of the sphere-drag correlation. HELD. An empirical fit, SHARED with the oracle on purpose. Planted in both files the published suite stays green. Taught as a stated limit and NEVER GRADED
constants.240: the low-Reynolds cap on that same correlation. HELD, on the same terms. MEASURED in section 2 by bisecting the vapour viscosity until the returned drag coefficient stops moving, with the Reynolds number the engine reports at that edge printed beside it. NEVER GRADED
constants.1.15 against 4/3: how API 521 packages the coefficient in the terminal-velocity balance. HELD as an ATTRIBUTION: no copy of the standard is in this repository, so which of the two the standard prints cannot be settled here. The engine evaluates the BALANCE, which is the derivation both forms come from, and the oracle recovers the exact coefficient by bisection on the force residual in SI. The digest prints the settling group at two droplet sizes and two viscosities so the coefficient is measured rather than attributed. NEVER GRADED as an attribution
constants.API 526 orifice table: fourteen published orifice areas D through T. HELD as a published TABLE: this package cannot derive one of them. Checked as BEHAVIOUR in the suite, the ladder, both selection boundaries and the refusal past the largest. The digest prints the ladder and the ratio of each row to the one below. NO GRADED FIELD IN THIS WAVE IS AN ORIFICE LETTER OR A MARGIN
constants.Kb: the balanced-bellows back-pressure factor for gas. HELD as a published CHART, so it is a typed input with its reference named. The engine takes 1.0 for a conventional valve in critical flow BY THE STANDARD and warns above a back-pressure ratio the digest MEASURES by bisection. In SUBCRITICAL flow the engine ignores Kb entirely and says so. NEVER GRADED
constants.Kw: the balanced-bellows factor for liquid. HELD as a published CHART, typed input, 1.0 for a conventional valve. NEVER GRADED
constants.KSH: the steam superheat factor. HELD as a published TABLE, typed input, 1.0 saturated. NEVER GRADED
constants.Kd: the certified discharge coefficient. A VENDOR'S CERTIFIED FIGURE, always STATED. The engine defaults, 0.975 for gas and steam and 0.65 for liquid, are placeholders for it. Every coefficient is validated on the way in: a certified coefficient is a fraction of an ideal, above zero and no more than one. Every capstone tier STATES its own, which is how no graded number rests on a chart
constants.Kc: the rupture-disc combination factor, 1.0 with no disc. A typed input on the same terms as Kb
constants.21000: the API 521 pool fire constant with adequate drainage and firefighting, Btu/hr per ft2 to the 0.82. HELD. The oracle checks the USC pair against the published SI pair with the exponent carried through the unit conversion, which checks the UNIT PACKAGING and not the pool-fire physics. MEASURED in section 2 at a unit area. NO GRADED FIELD IN THIS WAVE READS A FIRE DUTY OR A FIRE RELIEF LOAD
constants.34500: the same constant without drainage. HELD, on the same terms, with the factor between the two MEASURED in section 2. NEVER GRADED
constants.0.82: the pool fire area exponent. HELD, on the same terms. MEASURED in section 2 as the log ratio of two duties an order of area apart. NEVER GRADED
constants.1500: the pressure above which the Napier correction applies, psia. HELD as a published BOUNDARY: nothing here derives it and the suite pins it as behaviour. MEASURED in section 2 by bisecting where KN leaves unity. A graded steam area in this wave sits far below it, where KN is exactly 1.0 and no Napier coefficient is in the arithmetic
constants.3200: the top of the published Napier range, psia. HELD as a published BOUNDARY on the same terms, MEASURED in section 2 by bisecting where steamArea refuses
constants.1580.3: the pressure at which the Napier correction returns through 1.0. DERIVED from the fit and EXPORTED by the engine as NAPIER_UNITY_PSIA. Between 1500 and here the correction makes the required area LARGER, which the engine now warns about. MEASURED in section 2 two ways, by bisection and by reading the export
constants.0.1906 / 0.2292 / 1000 / 1061: the four coefficients of the Napier fit. DERIVED: the oracle checks the fit against the standard's own SI statement. All four are MEASURED in section 2 by solving the ratio of two lines from three pressures the engine is asked at
constants.25: the height above grade the wetted area counts to, ft. HELD as a published LIMIT, and the truncation is the CALLER's job because it depends on a plot elevation the engine is never told. It arrives as a note on every fire duty. Both capstone vessels are asserted short enough that it cannot bite
constants.4 pi: the solid angle in the API 521 point source. DERIVED: the oracle finds the sphere area by QUADRATURE of R^2 sin(theta) and the inverse by BISECTION on that same quadrature, so the model is checked rather than only self-consistent. MEASURED in section 2
constants.1.58 / 4.73 / 6.31 / 9.46: the four customary allowable radiant intensities, kW/m2, with their labels. HELD FOR LITERATURE: the values are customary and the wording is this package's own, with no source checked. Two engines in this package export the same table and the suite asserts they stay equal, so one learner cannot meet two sets of words for one table. A merged sibling course already teaches them. NO GRADED FIELD IN THIS WAVE READS A ROW OF IT: the Expert capstone STATES its own project allowable and the generator asserts it is none of these four
constants.1545.349: the universal gas constant the blowdown march stands on, ft.lbf per lbmol degR. DERIVED: the oracle uses the SI gas constant in its closed form. MEASURED in section 2 out of the mass the march reports for its own start state
constants.14.7: the atmospheric outlet pressure the gas route and the blowdown march default to, psia. DERIVED as a stated default and MEASURED THREE INDEPENDENT WAYS in section 2, because in critical flow the area does not move with the back pressure at all and the default cannot be recovered from an area there
constants.14.696 and 519.67: the package's own standard pressure and temperature. EXPORTED by the gas properties door and used in the digest's stated conversion of a standard rate to an actual one. The app's own drum tab uses 14.65 and 520 instead, which is why a graded drum field in this wave STATES its rate in actual cubic feet a second
constants.0.05: the fraction of the inventory no single blowdown step may remove. A stated CONVENTION of the repaired march, reported back as a substep count so a reader can see how often it bit
constants.7200: the default blowdown time limit, s. A stated CONVENTION, MEASURED in section 2 from below by bisecting the orifice at which the march just refuses
constants.900: fifteen minutes in seconds, the customary depressuring time the API 521 question is asked against. A CUSTOM rather than a constant of the engine: the engine never mentions it, and the digest BISECTS the orifice at which a vessel takes exactly that long rather than asserting a verdict
constants.z held constant, and choked flow through: two stated MODEL DECISIONS of the blowdown march. The oracle makes the same two deliberately, so what the published set checks is the march and not the thermodynamics. The engine now names the pressure below which the choked half stops holding, and the Expert capstone's end pressure is asserted more than three times above it
constants.the heads ignored in the wetted area: a stated MODEL DECISION, standard screening practice and conservative for the shell term

plan.state: FOUNDATION COMPLETE, vendored at engines 3bac13cd. Digest BUILT and since REBUILT on nine repairs, 29 sections, byte-reproducible across two consecutive rebuilds, five timezones and three locales. WRITTEN: all 78 lessons across the three tiers, the relief teaching lab, its three explorer panels and the capstone guard, and the lesson length gate. NOT WRITTEN: the 396 bank questions, the three per-tier key-truth audits, the five migrations and the ladder dry run.
plan.thesis: A relief system is sized by choosing the case, because every number this engine returns is the size that one chosen case demands, and the engine never chooses the case.

tiers.beginner: Associate. THE DEVICE, AND THE THREE FLUIDS IT PASSES. Why: the three API 520 sizing routes are the only part of this engine that runs in closed form from a stated load to an answer, so a learner can watch a whole answer assemble before anything iterates or marches. It is also where this module's own doctrine first bites: each route has EXACTLY ONE computed correction and EXACTLY ONE typed one, and the tier ends able to say which of the numbers on the page the engine worked out and which one somebody copied off a chart. The two things it teaches and never grades are the viscosity fit and the orifice letter, for the same reason: one is an empirical fit this package cannot derive and the other a published table it can only check as behaviour. The tier ends where the valve stops being the whole question.
tiers.intermediate: Professional. WHERE THE LOAD COMES FROM, AND WHERE THE LIQUID GOES. Why: the fire case is the one route in this engine that COMPUTES its own relief load, and it computes it from geometry, so this is where a sizing problem stops being arithmetic on a stated rate. A circular segment read exactly is right at half full whatever else is wrong with it, which is the one case anybody checks, and that lesson carries straight into the knockout drum, where the same geometry decides how much vapour space there is and how far a droplet has to fall. The tier ends able to say what a stated fraction is a fraction OF.
tiers.advanced: Expert. A VESSEL EMPTYING ITSELF, AND WHAT THE ANSWER RESTS ON. Why: the blowdown march is the only place this engine integrates rather than evaluates, so it is the only place a step size is part of the answer, and it is the one route whose validation is a CLOSED FORM of the same balance, which is what makes a hidden coefficient visible as a ratio. Then the point source, which this engine carries a second copy of and whose setback a merged sibling course owns. Then the audit, which on this engine is unusually rich: what was computed, what was typed, what nothing can check, and the difference between a published case that is missing and one that is present and cannot discriminate.

lessonLength.band: 420 to 560 words, ranked by est_minutes within a tier
lessonLength.measure: PROSE WORDS ONLY, counted the way lengths.py counts them: front matter, markdown table rows and {{panel:...}} lines are all excluded and HEADINGS ARE COUNTED. A raw `wc -w` over the whole file is NOT this measure and runs materially higher, so a lesson can be inside the band and still fail a raw word count. State which measure before quoting a number at a writer. This key used to say headings were excluded, as did four other places, while the wave shipped no lengths.py to settle it; FC5 headings carry 22 to 50 words each, a mean of 37.

capstones.beginner: KOLO CREEK, a gas plant with three relief cases on one train: the critical pressure ratio and the gas coefficient C at the train's own isentropic exponent, the required area in critical flow, the same load and the same valve against a pressured header so the subcritical branch is used, an inviscid liquid area, and a saturated steam area below the Napier threshold.
capstones.intermediate: OGBAINBIRI, a flow station: the wetted area of a horizontal vessel at a stated level, the same for a knockout tower standing beside it, the liquid area fraction of a circle filled to a stated depth, and the vapour velocity, the required length and the required length at the next diameter up for the flare knockout drum.
capstones.advanced: GBARAN, a compression station: the starting inventory, the time to the end pressure, the final temperature, the pressure below which the march's own choked assumption stops holding, and the point source asked both ways against a STATED project allowable.
capstones.heldItemCheck: Every held item is neutralised by CONSTRUCTION and every clearance is an ASSERTION the generator runs, twenty-eight of them, not a claim in a comment. The bellows chart is cleared twice over: the critical case is a conventional valve whose back-pressure ratio is asserted under 0.3 with the engine's warning asserted null, and the subcritical case is cleared BY CONSTRUCTION because the engine ignores Kb there, which is proved by running the same call at a different Kb and asserting the area is identical. The Kv fit is cleared because the liquid case is INVISCID, with Kv asserted exactly 1.0 and the returned Reynolds number asserted null, and a viscous call is run to prove the branch is not dead. The Napier boundaries are cleared because KN is asserted exactly 1.0 at a relieving pressure asserted below half the threshold. The orifice table is cleared because no graded key names a letter or a margin, asserted over all eighteen keys. The pool fire constants are cleared because no graded key reads a duty or a load, asserted the same way. The sphere-drag correlation is cleared because the drum STATES its design dropout velocity and its rate in actual cubic feet a second, with the absence of a droplet, a viscosity and a density from the condition set asserted. The 25 ft limit is cleared because both vessels are asserted short enough that it cannot bite. The choked assumption is cleared because the end pressure is asserted more than three times the engine's own choked floor with the warning asserted null. The radiation table is cleared because the allowable is a STATED project basis asserted to be none of the four customary values.
capstones.tolerances: DERIVED IN ONE PLACE AND NOWHERE ELSE: src/components/course/panels/relief/gradedTolerance.js in the NextGen repository holds the quantity class and the stated tolerance of each field and derives the rest. fc5_capstone.mjs imports it, make_fields.mjs writes fields.json and precision.json out of the same derivation, and the teaching lab must import it rather than restate a number from it. The rule is max(stated, half a unit in the last place the course PRINTS that class), MAX AND NEVER MIN, so it only ever loosens. Five of the eighteen were raised by the printed-precision floor and none is trivially wide. make_fields.mjs --bare-stated-tolerances is the negative control: it skips the widening, leaves PRINTED_DECIMALS alone, and exits 1 naming all five fields with the error that quoting the printed figure would carry.
capstones.discriminate: 104 plausible wrong methods aimed at the eighteen routes, at least three a field. ZERO WEAK ROUTES. Three restatements are declared EQUIVALENT with a reason and asserted NOT to move their answer, which is a second check rather than an exemption. discriminate.mjs --slack-tolerances is the negative control and reports eighteen weak routes.

At 0.495 and 0.505 they read correctly but the gate then resolved the wrong boundary off an adjacent line and turned the review into a FAIL. Tuning the digest further to the gate's heuristic would be writing for the gate rather than for the reader, which is the defect this wave has just spent a repair removing. EXIT 3 IS THE STANDING STATE OF THIS GATE ON THIS WAVE and it means one human read, not one failure. The proper fix is kit support for a straddle claim whose boundary is a row of the table it sits under.

history.engineComments: Repair-history comment lines in the engine source are PROVENANCE. Digest section 29 COUNTS them by reading the source and states the rule it counted with, rather than quoting a figure from a report. A sentence lifted out of a comment arrives with no frame, and a writer cannot frame what they did not know was history. Every writer brief in this wave says so, and names all four provenance files: RECON.md, FINDINGS.md, the engine source comments, and the repair's own FINDINGS-relief.md vendored beside the oracle.
history.framingRule: Framing comes from the HEADING above a passage or the line immediately before it. An inline prefix inside a sentence is not framing and the gate does not read it as one.

The blowdown's two moved because a hidden second discharge coefficient was removed, the march is midpoint rather than Euler, and the final step lands ON the end pressure. namingCollisions.relief: bare 'relief' already means a relief WELL in the drilling courses. Always write 'pressure relief' or 'relief valve'.
namingCollisions.safety valve: bare 'safety valve' already means the downhole SCSSV across about twenty lessons of completion and integrity. Always write 'pressure safety valve (PSV)'.
namingCollisions.back pressure: bare 'back pressure' already means the MPD choke in hydraulics and wellcontrol and the Rawlins and Schellhardt equation in nodal and welltest. Always qualify it as back pressure at the relief valve outlet. Associate m01 l03 disambiguates all three senses before any is used.

openItems.the kit has no support for a declared hi: digest_prose.rules.mjs NARROWS ONE kit rule. The kit's general repair-history heading rule fails any heading carrying USED TO, with no exemption for a section that declares itself as history, and FC5's SECTION 29 title says WHAT THIS ENGINE USED TO DO, which is the clearest frame for a reader and the exact phrase the rule hunts. The narrowing is by the two EXACT heading strings, it refuses if the kit rule disappears or stops firing on that title, and any other heading in this digest carrying that wording still fails, which is proved by a planted control. THE PROPER FIX IS KIT SUPPORT FOR A WAVE'S DECLARED HISTORY SECTION, and this narrowing should be deleted the day that exists.

Both are contrastives in text a learner sees on a screen. The digest quotes them VERBATIM because a digest that paraphrases an error message teaches a message the learner will never meet, and gate_copy_rule.py exempts exactly those two strings by exact string with a dead exemption failing. THE FIX IS UPSTREAM in petrolord-engines and is not an FC5 change.
